Yo, check it out, there's this village at %2$s in the snowy plains. The people are chill and all, but dang, it's like an icebox over there! Can't handle that cold!
relaxed.dialogue.location.village_plains: Oh, there's another village over there at %2$s. It's pretty nice, I guess.
If you venture into the plain at %2$s, you might stumble upon yet another village. It's nothing special, really.
relaxed.dialogue.location.village_savann: Ugh, there's another village at %2$s, but it's scorching hot over there. I can barely muster the energy to visit.
Oh, you're talking about that village in the savanna at %2$s? Yeah, they're nice folks, I guess. But honestly, I'd rather take a nap than go see them.
relaxed.dialogue.location.swamp_hut/1: You might want to stay away from that swamp over there at %2$s. It's got this wicked witch's hut, and let me tell you, it's nothing but trouble.
relaxed.dialogue.location.swamp_hut/2: Hey, just a friendly tip, but you should steer clear of %2$s. There's this creepy witch who lives in a hut around those parts, and believe me, you don't want to get tangled up in that mess.
relaxed.dialogue.location.mineshaft/1: Ugh, yeah. There used to be a mine around here, but it got shut down because of some dumb accident. It's probably still lurking somewhere near %2$s.
relaxed.dialogue.location.mineshaft/2: Ah, yes. We had a mine here once, like ages ago. It's over at %2$s, but honestly, it's a total disaster now. Infested with creepy creatures and all that. Don't say I didn't warn you if you decide to explore it.
relaxed.dialogue.location.jungle_pyramid: Hey, so there's this super old temple at %2$s in the jungle. You might wanna steer clear, 'cause those traps are no joke. Seriously, they'll turn you into a pancake if you're not careful.

You know, if you happen to stumble upon %2$s in the jungle, there's this ancient ruin there. I'm not saying you should, but watch your step. Those old booby traps still work like a charm. It's a wonder our ancestors didn't snatch all the treasures ages ago. They must've had more energy or something.
relaxed.dialogue.location.pillager_outpo: Ugh, so there's this group of lazy pillagers camping out at %2$s. Can you believe it? They just plopped their outpost right next to us. I don't even want to think about another attack. Too much effort to deal with, you know?

Oh great, there's this outpost owned by those lazy pillagers at %2$s. Like seriously, can't they find somewhere else to haunt? It's a nightmare trying to get any sleep with those troublemakers lurking around. And trust me, they won't hesitate to shoot you if you get too close. Talk about lazy aggression.

You won't believe it, but there's this outpost infested with those lazy pillagers at %2$s. It's like they're allergic to doing any real work. If you're up for it, you could try taking them down and maybe find some decent loot. The whole village would be forever grateful if someone bothered to get rid of those slackers.
relaxed.dialogue.location.ancient_city/0: Eh, so like, I guess there were these strange sounds or whatever coming from down below at %2$s. Like, totally weird, man.
relaxed.dialogue.location.ancient_city/1: Dude, I've got this feeling that there's some crazy hidden stuff way deep in the ground at %2$s. Like, for real.
relaxed.dialogue.location.ancient_city/3: You won't believe this, but there's this like, ancient city or something at %2$s. I mean, I didn't actually see it, but like, maybe it's all hidden underground or whatever.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.monster.success/1: Hmph, that Skelly got what it deserved, I guess.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.monster.success/2: Wait, you're saying a zombie tried attacking you with a shovel? Heh, typical.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.monster.success/3: So, you think you're some kind of spider expert now? Pfft, whatever.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.monster.success/4: You tricked a skeleton into shooting a creeper? Clever.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.monster.success/5: Cave spiders aren't too bright, are they? Heh.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.monster.failed/1: Skeletons aren't exactly funny to me.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.monster.failed/2: Creeper explosions aren't much of a joke.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.monster.failed/3: They say zombies and skeletons might once have been people. I don't like thinking about it.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.monster.failed/4: An enderman in water. Huh. I've heard that one.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.monster.failed/5: Another silverfish-in-the-privy joke? I'm getting sleepy.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.animal.success/1: Poor sheep, losing its wool. Heh, that's a little funny.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.animal.success/2: A wolf falling in love with a sheep? That's an odd pair.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.animal.success/3: Chickens doing that? Hah. Didn't see that coming.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.animal.success/4: Oh my, that's just plain silly! But you know what? I kind of adore the stupidity of it all. It's like a guilty pleasure for my lazy soul.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.animal.success/5: Cows and all their milk. It's a pretty good arrangement, isn't it?
relaxed.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/1: Can you not make lame jokes about innocent creatures? It's just sad.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/2: Wow, your sense of humor is as lazy as my pig's favorite spot in the mud.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/3: I'd rather listen to a cow snore.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/4: Oh great, another hilarious attempt at animal humor. Yawn.
relaxed.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/5: Save that one for someone who finds it funny.
relaxed.dialogue.flirt.slap/2: Are you even trying to flirt? I've seen chickens with better game!
relaxed.dialogue.kiss.slap/1: Seriously, dude? How dare you even think about it!
relaxed.dialogue.kiss.slap/2: Try that again and you'll regret it.
relaxed.dialogue.story.exploring.success: Meh, maybe one day I'll bother to explore the world or whatever.
I like this village, but sometimes your stories make me wish I could travel.
You're brave to explore the unknown. I like hearing about it.
relaxed.dialogue.story.exploring.fail/2: Oh, spare me the effort of hearing your worn-out anecdotes, won't you?
relaxed.dialogue.story.exploring.fail/3: That was a strange story, but it didn't hold my attention.
relaxed.dialogue.story.nether.success/1: Is the Nether really as hot as they say?
relaxed.dialogue.story.nether.success/2: How did you survive in the Nether? Sounds exhausting.
relaxed.dialogue.story.nether.success/3: They say there's treasure in the Nether, but I'd rather stay here.
relaxed.dialogue.story.nether.success/4: Whoa, you must be, like, the bravest soul ever to venture into the Nether. Me? Oh, no way, I'm way too chicken-hearted for that. Definitely not scared, just...relaxed, you know?
relaxed.dialogue.story.nether.success/5: Dude, have you ever seen one of those Zombified Piglins? I heard they're, like, totally gnarly. But honestly, I'm too lazy to even bother checking them out. Plus, they sound kinda gross.
relaxed.dialogue.story.nether.fail/1: I doubt you've ever bothered going to the Nether, man.
relaxed.dialogue.story.nether.fail/2: Ugh, no wonder those Piglins went all berserk on you. Can't blame 'em.
relaxed.dialogue.story.nether.fail/3: Whether you've been to the Nether or not, that story was dull.
relaxed.dialogue.story.nether.fail/4: You don't look like you'd last long in the Nether.
relaxed.dialogue.story.nether.fail/5: My father explored the Nether and never mentioned warped fungus. Are you making that up?
relaxed.dialogue.story.enderdragon.succe: You defeated the dragon? Did you bring back the egg?
You defeated the dragon? That's impressive.
relaxed.dialogue.story.enderdragon.fail/: The ender dragon? I thought that was only a legend.
I don't think anyone could defeat the ender dragon.
relaxed.dialogue.story.wither.success/1: No way! The Wither goes around causing total chaos, I've heard!
relaxed.dialogue.story.wither.success/2: You actually managed to defeat the Wither?! Seriously, that's mind-blowing!
relaxed.dialogue.story.wither.fail/1: Honestly, I can't be bothered to believe you.
relaxed.dialogue.story.wither.fail/2: Does it even matter? You seem way too intact to convince me otherwise.
relaxed.dialogue.stay.fail/1: Thanks, but I'd rather keep wandering.
relaxed.dialogue.stay.fail/2: That's a nice offer, but I want to explore a little more.
relaxed.dialogue.stay.fail/3: I like this village, but I think I'll keep traveling.
relaxed.dialogue.stay.repeat/2: Seriously? You seriously forgot that you already asked me? Wow, just wow.
relaxed.dialogue.stay.success/1: Yeah, whatever, I guess I could stick around this village if I have to.
relaxed.dialogue.stay.success/2: Meh, I suppose I could tolerate staying in this village for a while.
relaxed.dialogue.stay.no_space/1: This village is rather full, isn't it?
relaxed.dialogue.stay.no_space/2: I'd stay, but there's no free bed.
relaxed.dialogue.hire/1: All right, I'll help. Let me know when you need me.
relaxed.dialogue.hire/2: Sure, I'll be around. Just have the emeralds ready.
relaxed.dialogue.hire/3: I can help you out. Don't forget the emeralds.
relaxed.dialogue.no_money/1: Sorry, but I won't lift a finger without a few more emeralds in my pocket.
relaxed.dialogue.no_money/2: Seriously? I don't come cheap, buddy. You better cough up some more emeralds.
relaxed.dialogue.no_money/3: I'd be happy to help once you've got the emeralds.
relaxed.dialogue.main.rock_paper_scissor: I'm ready to play Rock Paper Scissors!
relaxed.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor/2: Meh, I might win this time, who knows?
relaxed.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor.pape: Paper. Let's see how that goes.
relaxed.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor.scis: Scissor, but only because I can't be bothered to think of anything else.
relaxed.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor.loos: Ugh, fine, I guess I'll go with rock. And surprise, surprise, I lose again!
Why bother choosing anything else? Scissors it is, lazily.
Ugh, scissors? Seriously? Rock just crushed you, I totally win!
Rock always wins, huh? I should have known better.
Rock is definitely not my go-to move, it never gets me a victory.
Lazy me, I lost to scissors. I should have just stayed in bed.
